papers.title: Subliminal Learning Crosses Modalities
papers.abstract: Subliminal learning refers to a surprising phenomenon in language models wherein a prompt given to one model (e.g., preference for cats) can be subliminally distilled to another model via training on data that is ostensibly meaningless (e.g., number sequences). This paper shows that text-based subliminal learning transfers cross-modally, in particular, a topic/preference (e.g., animals) transferred through number sequences across vision-language models also changes how images are generated and represented. First, we show that a diffusion model using the student as its text encoder generates the student's animal more often than with the original model as its text encoder, but not its color or style. We then investigate the mechanism behind this phenomenon and which concepts transfer across modalities. A constant component of the student's change accounts for much of the shift of image representations toward the trait. Adding this component uniformly can change the generated animal, which depends on the whole prompt, but not concepts such as color or style, which are encoded in a single token. Finally, we introduce weight lens as an approach to identify a subliminal trait from the weights of a single trained model, and show that it identifies the trait of nearly every student, including traits that do not surface in generated images.

ai_summary.problem: 论文研究语言模型中的潜意识学习（subliminal learning）是否能跨模态迁移，即通过看似无意义的数字序列传递的偏好或主题，是否会影响视觉-语言模型的图像生成与表征。
ai_summary.method: 作者先让学生在数字序列上训练以继承教师模型的偏好，再用学生作为文本编码器驱动扩散模型生成图像，观察主题、颜色、风格等概念是否迁移；随后分析学生表征变化中的恒定分量，并提出 weight lens 从单个模型权重中识别潜意识特征。
ai_summary.result: 实验发现动物主题/偏好可以跨模态迁移并影响图像生成与表征，而颜色和风格不迁移；学生变化中的恒定分量能解释大部分图像表征偏移，weight lens 能识别几乎所有学生的潜意识特征，包括未在生成图像中显现的特征。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次展示基于文本的潜意识学习可跨模态迁移到视觉生成与表征，并给出机制分析与从权重识别隐藏特征的方法。
ai_summary.relevance: 该发现对AI安全、隐私泄露、模型对齐和跨模型/跨模态的隐藏行为传播具有重要警示意义。

papers.title: Many Senses, One World: Learning Hierarchical Multimodal World Representations for Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation
papers.abstract: Bimanual dexterous manipulation relies on multimodal inputs that capture visual context and non-visual physical interaction cues for precise and coordinated control. To address the challenge of effectively integrating these modalities for policy learning, we propose HiMoDex, a two-stage framework centered on hierarchical multimodal world-state representations. In Stage 1, we pretrain a hierarchical representation network on the collected dataset of 1.19 million synchronized multimodal time steps. The network integrates visual context with tactile, force-torque, and audio cues into unified world-state embeddings. In Stage 2, we freeze the pretrained network and use its embeddings to condition a shared world-action transformer. The transformer jointly learns action generation and action-conditioned future-state prediction. Experiments across five real-world tasks show that HiMoDex achieves an average success rate of 78.7\%, representing an absolute improvement of 32.0\% over the strongest evaluated baseline. Extensive ablations validate the benefits of hierarchical representation learning and two-stage training. Failure analysis helps explain performance differences across variants. Code, data, and demos will be released at https://anonymous.4open.science/w/research-website-BAB4/.

ai_summary.problem: 双臂灵巧操作需要同时利用视觉上下文以及触觉、力觉、音频等非视觉物理交互线索，如何有效融合这些多模态信息来学习协调且精确的控制策略是核心难题。
ai_summary.method: 提出 HiMoDex 两阶段框架：第一阶段在 119 万同步多模态时间步数据上预训练分层表征网络，将视觉、触觉、力扭矩和音频整合为统一的世界状态嵌入；第二阶段冻结该网络，用其嵌入条件化一个共享的 world-action transformer，联合学习动作生成与动作条件下的未来状态预测。
ai_summary.result: 在五个真实世界任务上平均成功率达到 78.7%，相较最强基线绝对提升 32.0%；消融实验验证了分层表征学习和两阶段训练的有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是面向双臂灵巧操作的分层多模态世界状态表征，并结合冻结表征与共享 world-action transformer 进行动作生成和未来状态联合预测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中的多模态世界模型与策略学习提供了一种可扩展的两阶段范式，强调了非视觉物理线索在世界表征中的作用。

papers.title: LeanWAM: Learning Latent World Action Models from Frozen Video Models
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) typically adapt large pretrained video generators to jointly predict future observations and robot actions, incurring substantial training and deployment costs. However, it remains unclear which future representations a policy actually needs and how compactly they can be represented. Our probing study shows that complementary future representations can be compressed into a few tokens while retaining most of their action-decoding performance. Motivated by this finding, we introduce LeanWAM, a latent WAM that transfers video priors from a frozen video generator to a lightweight policy via two-stage training. In the first stage, a Future Extractor compresses observed transitions into 32 predictive tokens. These tokens condition the frozen generator and are jointly shaped by action, RGB, semantic, and geometric supervision, while a compact readout of the generator's hidden states supplies complementary world tokens. The second stage distills both representations into the policy, which learns to predict them from current observations while generating actions. With 1.4B parameters and no large-scale embodied pretraining, LeanWAM outperforms strong vision-language-action (VLA) and WAM baselines on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin~2.0. It predicts an action chunk in 25.1\,ms on an A100 GPU, 12.3--41.5$\times$ faster than representative WAMs. These results demonstrate that compact predictive supervision can transfer video priors to robust and efficient control.

ai_summary.problem: 世界动作模型（WAM）通常需要适配大型预训练视频生成器来联合预测未来观测和机器人动作，训练与部署成本很高；同时尚不清楚策略真正需要哪些未来表征、这些表征能被压缩到多紧凑。
ai_summary.method: 论文通过探测实验发现互补的未来表征可压缩为少量 token 且保留大部分动作解码性能，于是提出 LeanWAM：第一阶段用 Future Extractor 将观测转移动压缩为 32 个预测 token，在冻结视频生成器条件下结合动作、RGB、语义和几何监督，并从生成器隐状态读出互补 world token；第二阶段将这两类表征蒸馏到轻量策略中，使策略从当前观测预测未来表征并生成动作。
ai_summary.result: LeanWAM 以 1.4B 参数且无需大规模具身预训练，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上优于强 VLA 与 WAM 基线；在 A100 上预测一个动作块仅需 25.1ms，比代表性 WAM 快 12.3–41.5 倍。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是用少量紧凑预测 token 将冻结视频生成器的世界先验蒸馏给轻量策略，实现高效的世界动作建模。
ai_summary.relevance: 表明紧凑预测监督可把视频先验迁移到鲁棒且高效的机器人控制中，为降低世界动作模型的训练与部署成本提供了新路径。

papers.title: GoldiBench: Right Tools, Wrong Amount -- Benchmarking Agents on Effect Judgement in Professional Editing
papers.abstract: Real editing requests describe a look, not the steps to reach it, so an agent that serves them must judge how much of each tool the look takes. Existing benchmarks do not measure this: their tasks either state the tools and values, or leave the amount open and are scored by VLM judges that pass more than half of half- and triple-strength results. We introduce GoldiBench, a benchmark of 500 editing tasks in five professional applications (darktable, RawTherapee, GIMP, Inkscape, Blender), solvable by writing a program or by operating the GUI. Each task pairs a START image with a TARGET rendered from a hidden program, so the amount is fixed by a known target; the agent's edit is re-rendered and compared with TARGET, and the same task is posed with the tools and values, the tools only, or the goal only, separating operation from effect judgement. Across 25 open, GUI and closed models, agents operate well (99-100% with programs from 4B up when told the values) but fall off a cliff when they must judge the amount: given only the tools, the best model passes 19% of the tasks with programs and 33% through the GUI, and scale does not close the gap. Manuals barely help; the measured TARGET-START difference more than doubles the pass rate, but the same difference shown as an image does not for open models. Allowed four renders, agents almost always stop after the first; forced to compare, the strong models double their pass rate. Agents know the tools, but neither read nor check the amount.

ai_summary.problem: 现有编辑类Agent基准要么直接给出工具和参数值，要么由VLM评判开放式修改量，无法有效衡量Agent是否能在只知道目标效果时判断每个工具该用多少。
ai_summary.method: 提出GoldiBench，包含5个专业软件（darktable、RawTherapee、GIMP、Inkscape、Blender）中的500个编辑任务，每个任务由START图、隐藏程序生成的TARGET图以及程序/GUI两种解法构成，并分别以“给工具+数值”“只给工具”“只给目标”三种设置分离操作能力与效果判断能力。
ai_summary.result: 25个模型在被告知参数值时操作成功率可达99-100%，但仅给工具时最佳模型程序解法仅19%、GUI解法仅33%，扩大模型规模也无法弥补；提供TARGET-START数值差异可使通过率翻倍以上，而图像形式差异对开源模型帮助不大，且Agent通常只渲染一次就停止。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用已知目标渲染和分层提示设置，将Agent的“会用工具”与“会判断效果强度”解耦并进行可量化评测。
ai_summary.relevance: 揭示了当前Agent在专业软件操作中普遍缺乏效果判断与结果校验能力，为世界模型、多模态Agent和计算机操作Agent的评测与改进提供了重要基准。

papers.title: Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D
papers.abstract: While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate 3D geometry, how to effectively exploit it for precise and generalizable action prediction remains a central challenge. We introduce Hi3R-VLA, a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities - vision, language, and action - in explicit 3D geometry for robotic manipulation. Our model integrates spatially-aligned visual features and language conditioning into point cloud representations, enriching scene geometry with fine-grained, task-relevant semantics. It then anchors low-level control commands in the same 3D coordinate frame and uses 3D-RoPE enhanced action-to-point attention over coarse-to-fine point features to model geometric relationships between action targets and observed points. Our analysis demonstrates the importance of semantic fusion within 3D and spatial alignment between observations and actions. With fewer than 250M trainable parameters, Hi3R-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa, RLBench, RoboTwin2, DexJoCo and DexSuite across diverse manipulation tasks and embodiments, from single-arm and dual-arm grippers to dexterous hands. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate its effectiveness in the physical world. The model, code and dataset are publicly released at https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/hi3r_vla.html.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽越来越多地引入3D几何，但如何有效利用3D信息实现精确且可泛化的机器人动作预测仍是核心挑战。
ai_summary.method: 提出Hi3R-VLA，将视觉、语言和动作统一锚定在显式3D点云几何中；把空间对齐的视觉特征与语言条件融合进点云表示，并将低层控制命令锚定到同一3D坐标系，使用3D-RoPE增强的action-to-point注意力在由粗到细的点特征上建模动作目标与观测点之间的几何关系。
ai_summary.result: 模型少于250M可训练参数，在RoboCasa、RLBench、RoboTwin2、DexJoCo和DexSuite上，跨单臂、双臂夹爪和灵巧手等多种操作任务与具身形态达到SOTA，真机评估验证了物理世界有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是在显式3D几何中统一视觉、语言与动作模态，并将动作命令锚定到同一3D坐标框架，结合3D-RoPE增强的action-to-point注意力建模动作与场景点的几何关系。
ai_summary.relevance: 为3D几何驱动的VLA和具身操作提供了有效范式，有助于提升机器人操作在跨任务、跨本体形态下的精确性与泛化能力。

papers.title: Gaze World Model
papers.abstract: Where a person looks indicates their focus of attention, and how their gaze shifts between targets reveals how that attention responds to a changing scene. Existing gaze target estimation methods largely operate frame by frame and do not model these shifts. Gaze shifts are often driven by dynamic changes in the scene, which is the kind of information world models are designed to encode. This relationship is subtle, however, since an event far across the frame may produce only a slight movement of the person's head or eyes. We therefore introduce the Gaze World Model (GWM), which co-trains latent scene prediction with person-conditioned gaze supervision on a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder; in our ablations, the latent prediction objective improves both shift detection and gaze localization. Given a video clip and the person's head box, GWM estimates gaze locations and detects gaze shifts in the observed clip, and forecasts future gaze and shifts from predicted scene features. To train and evaluate these tasks, we augment VideoAttentionTarget and ChildPlay with event-level gaze-shift annotations. GWM achieves state-of-the-art shift detection on these benchmarks, about 10 points higher in four-class AP than the strongest baseline, while remaining comparable to the strongest image-based models in gaze target estimation, and outperforms the compared baselines on future gaze localization and shift forecasting.

ai_summary.problem: 现有注视目标估计方法基本是逐帧处理，没有建模注视点之间的转移，而注视转移往往由场景的动态变化驱动，这种细微关系难以捕捉。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Gaze World Model（GWM），在冻结的 V-JEPA 2.1 编码器上联合训练潜在场景预测与以人物为条件的注视监督；输入视频片段和人物头部框，即可估计注视位置、检测片段内的注视转移，并基于预测的场景特征外推未来的注视与转移。同时为 VideoAttentionTarget 和 ChildPlay 增加事件级注视转移标注。
ai_summary.result: 在两个基准上取得最优的注视转移检测性能，四分类 AP 比最强基线高约 10 个点；注视目标估计与最强图像模型相当，并在未来注视定位与转移预测上优于对比基线。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将世界模型的潜在场景预测目标与注视转移检测/预测联合建模，用场景动态变化来解释注意力的转移。
ai_summary.relevance: 把世界模型与人类注意力建模连接起来，对 AR/VR、社交机器人和人机交互中的意图理解具有潜在价值。

papers.title: SceneMemBench: A Benchmark for Scene Memory in Interactive Video World Models
papers.abstract: Interactive video world models generate navigable worlds frame by frame, but a persistent world requires previously observed scenes to remain recoverable as users move away and return. Existing memory evaluations, however, often focus on seen-view revisits and full rollouts, leaving cross-view scene recovery underexplored while entangling memory with trajectory-following errors and accumulated generation degradation. We introduce SceneMemBench, a benchmark for scene memory in interactive video world models. It evaluates two complementary dimensions: seen-view recall versus novel-view recovery, and controlled diagnosis versus end-to-end interaction. We introduce Continued Rollout from a shared ground-truth observation history, alongside Full Rollout over complete model-generated interactions. SceneMemBench contains 600 controlled trajectories across 33 Unreal Engine scenes and 60 Full Rollout cases, covering eight representative open- and closed-source models. We evaluate scene recovery along subject consistency, appearance fidelity, and geometric consistency. Results show that novel-view recovery is generally more challenging than seen-view recall, while model profiles under controlled histories can differ markedly from those observed in full interaction. Together, these findings reveal complementary failure modes obscured by seen-view revisits or end-to-end rollouts alone.

ai_summary.problem: 现有交互式视频世界模型的记忆评估主要关注已见视角重访和完整 rollout，跨视角场景恢复能力未被充分考察，且记忆与轨迹跟随误差、生成退化相互纠缠。
ai_summary.method: 提出 SceneMemBench 基准，从“已见视角回忆 vs. 新视角恢复”和“受控诊断 vs. 端到端交互”两个维度评估场景记忆；设计基于共享真实观测历史的 Continued Rollout 与完整模型交互的 Full Rollout，覆盖 33 个 Unreal Engine 场景、600 条受控轨迹和 60 个 Full Rollout 案例，并从主体一致性、外观保真度和几何一致性评估 8 个代表性模型。
ai_summary.result: 新视角恢复通常比已见视角回忆更具挑战性，且模型在受控历史下的表现画像可能与完整交互中明显不同，揭示了单一评估方式会掩盖的互补失败模式。
ai_summary.novelty: 通过共享真实观测历史的受控 Continued Rollout 与端到端 Full Rollout 对照，将场景记忆能力从轨迹误差和累积生成退化中解耦评估。
ai_summary.relevance: 为交互式视频世界模型的持久场景记忆提供了更细粒度、可诊断的标准化评测基准，有助于推动真正可导航、可回访的世界模型发展。

papers.title: VISOR: A Vision-Language Selector for Multimodal Time-Series Forecasting
papers.abstract: Recent time-series foundation models (TSFMs) forecast a distribution over futures, and multimodal time-series (TS) forecasting further exploits other modalities to improve forecasting accuracy. However, existing works have two limitations: 1) TSFMs reduce the predictive distribution to its median or mean, flattening diverse futures into a calm line, and 2) multimodal TS forecasting models incorporate text into the forecaster through TS-language alignment, which is substantially weaker than vision-language alignment. To address these limitations, we propose the VIsion-language SelectOR (VISOR), a multimodal TS forecasting framework that selects one plausible future instead of averaging across candidates, leveraging the alignment capabilities of vision-language models (VLMs) to select the most suitable candidate based on textual information. VISOR consists of two components: 1) a text-free stochastic predictor that samples diverse candidate futures, and 2) a VLM selector that reads the candidates as a single chart image and selects one based on the text. To avoid overly calm forecasting paths, we train the selector with a shape-aware target that evaluates each candidate based on both point-wise error and path shape. Across three benchmarks covering ten datasets, VISOR achieves the best average ranking in both point and volatility errors compared with TSFMs and multimodal TS forecasting models. Code: https://github.com/seunghan96/VISOR.

ai_summary.problem: 现有多模态时间序列预测方法存在两个缺陷：时间序列基础模型（TSFM）将预测分布压缩为中位数或均值，把多样的未来拉平成平缓曲线；多模态方法通过时间序列-语言对齐引入文本，而对齐能力远弱于视觉-语言对齐。
ai_summary.method: 提出 VISOR 框架，不再对候选未来求平均，而是从候选中选择一个合理的未来。它包含两个组件：(1) 无文本的随机预测器，采样多样化的候选未来；(2) 基于视觉语言模型（VLM）的选择器，将候选未来渲染为一张图表图像，再根据文本信息选出最合适的一个；训练时使用形状感知目标，同时评估逐点误差和路径形状，以避免过于平缓的预测路径。
ai_summary.result: 在覆盖十个数据集的三个基准上，VISOR 在逐点误差和波动率误差上的平均排名均优于 TSFM 和多模态时间序列预测模型。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将视觉语言模型用于从候选未来中选择而非平均，并把候选未来可视化为单张图表，结合形状感知目标训练选择器。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态时间序列预测提供了新范式，即利用 VLM 的视觉-语言对齐能力进行候选选择，避免基础模型预测分布塌缩，对时间序列基础模型与多模态 Agent 结合有启发意义。

papers.title: Dreamcatcher: Remembering What Surprises a World Model in Video Streams
papers.abstract: As live video streams grow longer, repeatedly encoding and processing their full histories becomes increasingly costly. Answering questions as they arrive therefore calls for visual memory built in one pass before future questions are known. Existing methods mainly keep tokens that differ from earlier ones or match surrogate queries fixed in advance. Without modeling world dynamics, these criteria struggle to tell subtle surprising details from expected change. We introduce Dreamcatcher, a training-free framework and, to our knowledge, the first to use predictive signals from an independently pretrained, frozen video world model for online memory formation in streaming video question answering. Conditioned on recent history, the world model predicts incoming features using learned world priors. Its normalized prediction errors yield temporal and spatial surprisal signals that guide online segmentation and the retention of a frozen Video-LLM's native visual tokens, balancing surprising details with broad visual coverage under budgets that decay with segment age. At query time, an evidence gate admits a segment from a similarity-based shortlist only when the Video-LLM judges that it adds evidence for the question beyond the current view. We evaluate Dreamcatcher on three streaming and three offline long-video benchmarks. On OVO-Bench, Dreamcatcher achieves the highest overall accuracy among the compared training-free methods for each of four frozen Video-LLMs, reaching 78.9% with Qwen3.8-27B. With the three Qwen Video-LLMs, it also reduces average input tokens for answer generation by more than 80% relative to their base models at 1 fps.

ai_summary.problem: 在持续增长的实时视频流中，反复编码完整历史代价高昂，而现有在线视觉记忆方法（保留差异 token 或依据预先固定的伪查询筛选）缺乏对世界动态的建模，难以区分“真正令人意外的细节”与“可预期的变化”，从而影响流式视频问答的准确性。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Dreamcatcher——一个无需训练的框架，首次利用独立预训练且冻结的视频世界模型的预测信号来构建在线记忆：以近期历史为条件让世界模型预测未来特征，用归一化预测误差生成时间与空间上的“surprisal”信号，指导在线分段与冻结 Video-LLM 原生视觉 token 的保留，并随片段年龄衰减预算以兼顾意外细节与整体覆盖；查询时通过“证据门”仅接纳能补充新证据的片段。
ai_summary.result: 在 3 个流式与 3 个离线长视频基准上评测，OVO-Bench 上对四种冻结 Video-LLM 均取得对比方法中最高总体准确率（Qwen3.8-27B 下达 78.9%），且在 1 fps 下将三个 Qwen Video-LLM 的答案生成平均输入 token 减少 80% 以上。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将独立预训练冻结视频世界模型的预测误差（surprisal）作为无需训练的在线记忆形成信号，用于流式视频问答的 token 选择与分段保留。
ai_summary.relevance: 为长视频流式理解提供了一条“用世界模型预测误差驱动记忆压缩”的新思路，兼顾效率与细节保留，对世界模型与多模态 Agent 的长期记忆设计有直接借鉴意义。
ai_summary.org: 卡内基梅隆大学（Carnegie Mellon University）

papers.title: RVLM-X: Towards a Universal VLM Harness
papers.abstract: Harnesses for vision-language models (VLMs) have grown with the models' capabilities, notably for images far larger than those seen in training, where downscaling loses small details. Most of them wrap the VLM in a fixed procedure, such as a zoom tree, that decides in advance where it looks and how the evidence is combined. These procedures make up for the weaknesses of older models by keeping them on a task-specific path, but with frontier models that reliably plan and use tools, they can lower accuracy. We propose RVLM-X, a task-generalizable recursive VLM harness that runs unchanged across photographs, charts and maps. Following the recursive inference of Recursive Language Models, the VLM programmatically controls its own visual context in a code REPL that holds the full-resolution image and calls itself recursively on regions that it chooses. With a cost-efficient frontier model as the base of every method, RVLM-X is more accurate than a single call on all 7 public benchmarks and has the highest pooled accuracy. Because existing benchmarks mostly test whether a model finds one small detail, we also introduce MapGenBench, procedurally generated maps whose questions combine fine-detail perception with multi-step reasoning. There, RVLM-X answers 71.4% of held-out questions against 55.5% for the strongest baseline. Overall, our findings suggest that as VLMs plan and use tools more reliably, letting the model write its own visual search works better than fixing one in advance.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉语言模型（VLM）的harness大多采用固定流程（如zoom tree），预先决定观察区域和证据组合方式，这类流程是为弥补旧模型的短板而设计的，但在能够可靠规划和使用工具的前沿模型上反而会降低准确率，而且难以跨任务泛化。
ai_summary.method: 提出RVLM-X，一种任务通用、可递归的VLM harness，在照片、图表和地图上无需改动即可运行。该harness让模型在代码REPL中编程式地控制自己的视觉上下文，REPL中保留全分辨率图像；模型对自己选定的区域递归调用自身，沿用Recursive Language Models的递归推理思路。此外，作者构建了MapGenBench，用程序化生成的地图问答数据，将细粒度感知与多步推理结合起来测试。
ai_summary.result: 以高性价比前沿模型作为所有方法的基座，RVLM-X在全部7个公开基准上均优于单次调用，并取得最高汇总准确率；在MapGenBench的held-out问题上准确率达71.4%，最强基线仅为55.5%。
ai_summary.novelty: RVLM-X让模型自己编写视觉搜索流程，而不是预先固定一条流程，并统一覆盖照片、图表和地图等多种视觉任务。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作表明，随着VLM的规划与工具使用能力不断增强，让模型自行编写视觉搜索流程，比预先固定一种流程效果更好；这为多模态Agent和高分辨率视觉推理提供了新范式。
ai_summary.org: 作者机构信息未在提供内容中明确给出

papers.title: BEARING: Who Is Talking to Whom? Grounding Acoustic Direction in Vision for Online Multi-Party Conversation
papers.abstract: Understanding a group conversation means deciding, from video and audio, who is speaking and to whom. Leading systems treat these tasks offline on single-channel clips and align models with a self-evaluation reward. We propose BEARING, a geometry-first alternative built on one measured signal: the direction from which a microphone array beside the camera hears a sound. A label-free calibration learned from the stream registers this direction into the camera image, and an online registry of faces, voices and directions needs no enrollment. The registered direction serves as (i) a visual prompt for a vision-language model, a marker on the speaker or an arrow toward an off-screen source; (ii) one input of a reliability-weighted fusion with visual active-speaker detection, for speakers in the same direction from the array; and (iii) a verifiable reward for alignment: the named speaker must sit where the sound comes from, the confidence must match that check, and always answering "group" earns nothing. Every decision is online, with the lookahead as an explicit parameter. On 9,498 addressee-labelled utterances from three AMI sites and egocentric EasyCom, the direction prompt raises speaker accuracy from 54% to 74%; addressee accuracy moves by about two points, because telling one addressee from the group depends on the words more than on where people are. For co-located speakers on AVDIAR, visual active-speaker detection holds 95% where direction alone falls to 59%. The verifiable reward beats self-evaluation under GRPO, reward-ranked fine-tuning and DPO; shrinking the lookahead from 5 s to 0.5 s costs 4.5 DER points on AMI, and learning the registration online costs a dip in the first two minutes before the system overtakes vision alone. Code and evaluation protocols will be released.

ai_summary.problem: 论文要解决在线多人对话中的说话人识别与“对谁说”（addressee）判定问题：现有系统多为离线、单通道，并用自评估奖励对齐模型，缺乏可验证的几何依据。
ai_summary.method: 提出 BEARING，以麦克风阵列测得的声源方向为核心信号：用无标签在线标定把声学方向配准到相机图像，并维护无需注册的人脸—语音—方向注册表；该方向既作为视觉提示（VLM 标记），也与视觉主动说话人检测做可靠性加权融合，同时充当可验证奖励（说话人须位于声源方向、置信度须与核验一致）。
ai_summary.result: 在 AMI 三个站点与 EasyCom 共 9,498 条带 addressee 标注的话语上，方向提示把说话人准确率从 54% 提升到 74%；在 AVDIAR 同位置说话人场景中，视觉主动说话人检测保持 95%（仅用方向则降至 59%）；可验证奖励在 GRPO、DPO 等训练下均优于自评估奖励。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次把声源方向作为可测量、可验证的几何枢纽，统一驱动在线说话人定位、多模态融合与强化学习奖励。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态对话理解与具身/社交智能体提供了无需注册、可在线部署且奖励可验证的声视融合范式。
ai_summary.org: 美国丹佛大学（University of Denver）

papers.title: Sparks of Weight-Space Programming for Robot Foundation Models
papers.abstract: This paper demonstrates an approach for correcting failures of robot foundation models (RFMs) without additional data collection, demonstrations, or training. We apply weight-space programming (WSP), in which a language-model agent directly reads and writes a neural network's parameters, to a large, pre-trained vision-language-action policy. The idea is simple: many policy failures are not random but repeatedly land in the same recognizable stuck state, so if that state is visible in the model's internal activations, a small edit could trigger a corrective movement while leaving the rest of the model's parameters unchanged. A core design choice is where to write the edit: repurposing a few near-silent neurons in the action expert lets the edit switch on in situations associated with the failure and produce a corrective movement, such as lowering the gripper toward the target, that is specified directly rather than learned through training. Empirically, when applied to the pi0.5 policy in simulation, we find that edits to roughly 0.0002% of the parameters can improve success on recurring failures, including for a policy that was already fine-tuned on its task. Reversed and random edits indicate that the gains come from the intended behavior, and the approach works best when the failure situation is recognizable and a simple correction can address it.

ai_summary.problem: 这篇论文要解决机器人基础模型（RFM）在部署中出现重复性失败时，无需额外数据采集、示范或训练即可修正策略的问题。
ai_summary.method: 作者将权重空间编程（WSP）应用于大规模预训练视觉-语言-动作策略，让语言模型智能体直接读写神经网络参数；核心设计是复用动作专家中少量近乎静默的神经元作为编辑位置，使编辑在可识别的失败状态下激活，并直接指定纠正动作。
ai_summary.result: 在仿真中对 pi0.5 策略的实验表明，仅编辑约 0.0002% 的参数即可提升重复性失败场景的成功率，包括已针对任务微调过的策略；反向和随机编辑验证了收益来自预期行为。
ai_summary.novelty: 创新点在于用权重空间编程和近静默神经元复用，对机器人基础模型进行无需数据与再训练的行为修复。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作展示了轻量、可解释的参数编辑作为机器人策略修复新范式的潜力，对模型编辑、具身智能和机器人基础模型部署有启发意义。
ai_summary.org: 未明确（原文未提供作者机构信息；Eugen Solowjow 的公开背景可能与 Siemens 相关）

papers.title: NOBODY Was There: Bridging the Human-VLM Gap in Unwarranted Person Attribution Bias
papers.abstract: Describing an image requires not only recognizing what is visible but deciding what should be inferred. We investigate a systematic gap between humans and VLMs in their tendency to attribute visible actions or events to people who are not present in an image. We term this behavior unwarranted person attribution bias and find that, across 25 SOTA VLMs, captions of person-absent scenes mention a person four times as often as human-written captions of the same images. Through a preference study, we further show that both humans and VLMs prefer captions that avoid such attributions. Motivated by this, we introduce NOBODY, a preference dataset designed to bridge the gap between humans and VLMs in unwarranted person attribution. Through direct preference optimization (DPO), we align open VLMs on NOBODY and show that their agreement with human captions on person attribution reaches or exceeds inter-human agreement, whereas nine existing public preference datasets leave this behavior largely unchanged. Furthermore, we show that human judges preferred the aligned VLM captions significantly more than those of the baseline model. Alongside NOBODY, we release NOBODY-Bench, which evaluates VLMs for unwarranted person attribution bias and their alignment against human captions and preference. Project page: https://pmadinei.github.io/NOBODY/

ai_summary.problem: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在描述人物缺席的图像时，倾向于把可见动作或事件归因于不在场的人，这与人类行为存在系统性差距，论文称之为“无依据人物归因偏差”。
ai_summary.method: 作者构建了偏好数据集 NOBODY，并用直接偏好优化（DPO）对齐开源 VLM；同时发布 NOBODY-Bench，用于评估该偏差以及模型与人类描述和偏好的一致性。
ai_summary.result: 对齐后的 VLM 在人物归因上与人类描述的一致率达到或超过人际一致率，人类评委也显著更偏好其描述；而 9 个现有公开偏好数据集基本未改善这一偏差。
ai_summary.novelty: 论文定义并系统测量了“无依据人物归因偏差”，并首次用专门的偏好数据和 DPO 来弥合人类与 VLM 在该行为上的差距。
ai_summary.relevance: 该工作对提升多模态模型图像描述的可靠性、减少无依据推断以及改进人类对齐评估具有重要意义。
ai_summary.org: University of California, Santa Barbara（根据作者信息推测）

papers.title: Look Before You Commit: Visual-Evidence-Guided Decoding for Multimodal Diffusion Language Models
papers.abstract: Diffusion multimodal large language models rely on confidence to decide when to commit candidate tokens during generation. In multimodal tasks, however, confidence cannot distinguish whether a candidate originates from image evidence or the language prior. We perform paired forward ablation and find that nearly nine out of ten high-confidence commits are insensitive to the image, while degenerate and hallucination samples exhibit significant increases in the entropy of deep-layer attention organization. Based on this diagnosis, we propose CD-APC, a training-free decoding method. CD-APC performs evidence-adjusted scoring within a base-supported pool and uses dual gating based on model acceptability and contrastive concentration to decide whether to commit, together with an inverse-window mechanism that adapts to inter-step difficulty. Across two backbones and five benchmarks, CD-APC consistently improves performance, indicating that stable visual evidence improves model outputs.

ai_summary.problem: 扩散式多模态大语言模型在生成时依赖置信度决定何时提交候选 token，但在多模态任务中置信度无法区分候选来自图像证据还是语言先验，导致大量高置信提交对图像不敏感并引发幻觉。
ai_summary.method: 作者先通过配对前向消融实验诊断该问题，发现近九成高置信提交对图像不敏感、退化与幻觉样本的深层注意力组织熵显著升高；据此提出免训练解码方法 CD-APC，在基础支持池内做证据调整打分，结合模型可接受性与对比集中度的双重门控决定是否提交，并用逆窗口机制自适应步间难度。
ai_summary.result: 在两个骨干模型和五个基准上，CD-APC 均取得一致的性能提升，表明稳定的视觉证据能够改善模型输出。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次系统诊断扩散多模态 LLM 解码中'置信度不等于视觉证据'的失效模式，并提出无需训练的视觉证据引导解码策略。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态扩散语言模型的可靠解码与幻觉抑制提供了新思路，对提升生成的可信度与视觉 grounding 具有实际意义。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: FabricBench: A Standardized Policy Benchmark for Bimanual Fabric Manipulation with a Contact-Driven Deformable Simulator
papers.abstract: Fabric manipulation challenges robot policies with changing geometry, self-occlusion, and contact, yet standardized evaluation remains focused on rigid objects. We introduce FabricBench, a benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with six tasks spanning garments, silk, and bags, 10,000 simulation-ready assets, and controlled tests of configuration and appearance generalization. Built on an open-source solver in Newton, our simulator enables stable bimanual grasping, holding, and release through contact forces, without artificial attachment. Redesigned cloth-rigid contact and bidirectional force coupling support interactions among robot arms, fabric, and free rigid objects, allowing a bag to support its contents and transmit their weight to the grippers. In a controlled grasp-hold-release evaluation, our solver succeeds in all 45 trials, compared with none for the tested baseline configurations. Evaluating six representative policies, including vision-language-action models and world action models, reveals substantial remaining challenges: the best policy achieves 77% average success, while no policy exceeds 36% on long-horizon T-shirt folding. Under the most deformed initial T-shirt configurations, success falls to 6-14% across policies, with larger drops than under the evaluated appearance shifts. Zero-shot deployment of $π_{0.5}$ on a real robot largely preserves task difficulty ordering across six tasks (Spearman $ρ=0.94$). These results establish FabricBench as a reproducible testbed for measuring fabric-manipulation capabilities and exposing limitations in configuration generalization. The project website is available at https://fabricbench.github.io/.

ai_summary.problem: 现有机器人操作评测主要面向刚体，缺乏针对双臂布料操作（形变、自遮挡、接触）的标准化基准与可复现仿真环境。
ai_summary.method: 提出 FabricBench：基于 Newton 开源求解器构建接触驱动可形变仿真器，支持双臂抓取、保持、释放及布料-刚体双向力耦合；包含6类任务、1万个仿真资产，并系统评测配置与外观泛化。
ai_summary.result: 在抓取-保持-释放测试中45次全部成功，基线均失败；评测6类代表性策略，最佳平均成功率77%，但长时T恤折叠不超36%，最形变初始配置下仅6-14%；π0.5实机零样本部署保持任务难度排序（Spearman ρ=0.94）。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个面向双臂布料操作的标准化策略基准，结合接触驱动可形变仿真、万级资产和配置/外观泛化受控评测。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能和机器人操作策略提供可复现的布料操作测试平台，揭示VLA/世界动作模型在形变物体泛化上的关键短板。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: Lit Up but Not Needed: Scoped Lesions Show Where Multimodal Mixture-of-Experts Depend on Their Experts
papers.abstract: Cognitive neuroscience learned that an activation map is not a map of necessity. Regions that light up during a task are not always needed for it, and only lesions reveal which ones are. Mixture-of-experts (MoE) vision-language models come with an activation map for free, since the router records which experts respond to image and text tokens, and recent work reads modality-specialized experts off this map. We bring the lesion. In Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B, Kimi-VL-A3B and Gemma-4-26B-A4B, 3 to 12% of the experts are vision-exclusive: image tokens route to them at up to five times the uniform rate and text tokens almost never. In Qwen3-VL they receive a quarter of all image-token routing, and lesioning all of them costs less than one percentage point on average over eight perception benchmarks and free-form OCR, no more than lesioning a random set of the same size. In Kimi-VL and Gemma-4 the lesion also costs no more than a random set. Scoped lesions, which remove an expert set only at image positions or only at text positions, then show where the models do depend on their experts. In Qwen3-VL, silencing every expert at every image position costs 3 points, against 45 at text positions, where the dependence sits in dual-use experts that text-only tasks need as well. Across models the image-side dependence is 2 to 3 points in Qwen3-VL and Kimi-VL and 26 in Gemma-4. Reading text in images is the one ability that needs image-position experts in every model. The exclusive experts receive informative patches, produce outputs of ordinary size, and stay inert under sensory deprivation: text-only training recruits them only when load balancing forces it. In Kimi-VL the balancing bias itself manufactures most of them. Load balancing draws the modality map in the part of the computation the models depend on least. Expert selection, pruning and skipping should follow the lesion, not the map.

ai_summary.problem: 多模态MoE视觉语言模型的router激活图（哪些专家响应图像/文本token）常被直接当作模态专家分工的证据，但认知神经科学表明激活图并不等于必要性图，本文要回答这些“模态专有专家”是否真的被模型所依赖。
ai_summary.method: 在Qwen3-VL-30B-A3B、Kimi-VL-A3B、Gemma-4-26B-A4B上先识别视觉专属专家，再用“消融/损伤”（lesion）实验将其整组移除，与同规模随机专家组对比；进一步提出“范围化损伤”（scoped lesion），只在图像位置或只在文本位置移除同一专家集合，以定位依赖究竟落在哪里，并配合纯文本训练与负载均衡偏置分析专属专家的成因。
ai_summary.result: 视觉专属专家占3–12%，在Qwen3-VL中承接约四分之一图像token路由，但全部损伤后八个感知基准与自由OCR平均掉点不到1个百分点，并不比随机损伤更多；范围化损伤显示Qwen3-VL图像位置全静默仅掉3分，而文本位置掉45分，依赖集中在兼用专家上；唯一在每个模型中都依赖图像位置专家的是“读图中的文字”（OCR）；负载均衡偏置本身制造了大部分专属专家。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次用“范围化损伤”把MoE多模态模型的激活图与必要性图分离，证明路由统计出的模态专有专家大多是可替代的“亮而不需”，并指出负载均衡是虚假专有化的来源。
ai_summary.relevance: 为MoE多模态模型的专家选择、剪枝与专家跳过（expert skipping）提供了“看损伤而非看激活图”的实证准则，避免把算力与压缩预算浪费在非必需专家上。
ai_summary.org: 未提供（作者机构信息缺失）

papers.title: AgentDRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction
papers.abstract: Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.

ai_summary.problem: 物理设计中的DRC（设计规则检查）错误修复长期依赖人工，是耗时瓶颈；现有LLM-agent方法因上下文图形冗余、对原始坐标的空间推理能力弱、以及扁平化布局表示效率低而效果不佳。
ai_summary.method: 提出AgentDRC，将迭代式DRC修复建模为多智能体算法：四个专门化Agent分别感知多层次、多模态的几何特征并过滤无关图形；核心是空间感知的验证与纠正算法，重建关键图形间的结构化空间关系，并通过几何与语义约束检查来校验修复方案。
ai_summary.result: 在困难违规案例上取得最高30.4%的pass@1和55.7%的pass@5，相比最佳基线pass@5提升13.8%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首次将DRC纠正重构为多智能体协同框架，并用结构化空间关系重建+几何/语义双重约束校验替代LLM对原始坐标的直接推理。
ai_summary.relevance: 展示了LLM多智能体在EDA这一高专业门槛工程领域的落地路径，为空间推理型Agent和芯片设计自动化提供了新范式。

papers.title: Co-DRIS: Physics-Informed Predictive Belief and Variable-Impedance Learning for Reactive Catching under Coupled Uncertainty
papers.abstract: Reactive robotic manipulation is acutely sensitive to simultaneous sensing noise, measurement dropouts, joint execution errors, and contact parameter variations. While single-frame frameworks like Domain-Randomized Instance Set (DRIS) achieve strong robustness under isolated uncertainties (86.4%), they degrade severely when perception and actuation uncertainties co-occur (27.6% across 10 coupled stress scenarios) due to memoryless encoding and fixed high-stiffness PD control. We propose Co-DRIS + SuperMimic, a perception-action co-design framework coupling: (i) an inertial world-frame physics-informed world model combining exact ballistic kinematics with a zero-initialized contact residual to roll forward missing observations and accelerate training via zero-cost counterfactual dropout consistency; (ii) an action-conditioned dual-stream causal GRU belief encoder resolving the denoising-vs-lag deadlock; and (iii) phase-aware variable-impedance soft-catching that transitions the 7-DoF Franka Research 3 arm into an overdamped regime (zeta/zeta0 ~ 2.26x) at the torque layer. Under unbiased 3-seed tail evaluation on unseen throws (15,360 throws/scenario), our method achieves 89.6 +/- 0.4% on standard benchmarks (+10.5% on 4-sigma noise to 70.5%) and 66.6 +/- 0.5% across 10 coupled/dropout stress scenarios (+39.0% over DRIS; +30.4% on 50% dropout). We further validate impedance decoupling, causal contact triggering under +0.65 s flight-time shifts, and cross-task transfer to steel-plate ping-pong bouncing (87.5% to 100.0%) and FR3+Hand catching (+8.4% under 4x noise with 6-13% lower peak impact force).

ai_summary.problem: 反应式机器人抓取在感知噪声、测量丢失、关节执行误差与接触参数变化同时发生时性能急剧下降——单帧框架（如 DRIS）在孤立不确定性下可达 86.4%，但在耦合压力场景下仅剩 27.6%。
ai_summary.method: 提出 Co-DRIS + SuperMimic 的感知-动作协同设计框架：(1) 惯性世界坐标系下的物理知情世界模型，用精确抛体运动学加零初始化接触残差前推缺失观测，并以零成本反事实 dropout 一致性加速训练；(2) 动作条件双流因果 GRU 信念编码器，化解“去噪 vs 滞后”的两难；(3) 相位感知的可变阻抗软抓取，在力矩层将 7-DoF FR3 机械臂切入过阻尼区（ζ/ζ0 ≈ 2.26×）。
ai_summary.result: 在未见抛掷的 3 种子尾部评测中，标准基准达 89.6±0.4%（4σ 噪声下 70.5%，+10.5%），10 个耦合/丢帧压力场景平均 66.6±0.5%（较 DRIS +39.0%，50% 丢帧下 +30.4%）；并验证了阻抗解耦、+0.65 s 飞行时间偏移下的因果接触触发，以及向钢板乒乓弹跳（87.5%→100.0%）和 FR3+灵巧手抓取的跨任务迁移（4× 噪声下 +8.4%，峰值冲击力降低 6–13%）。
ai_summary.novelty: 将物理知情世界模型、因果信念编码与相位感知可变阻抗控制在感知-动作协同设计中统一，专门对抗感知与执行的耦合不确定性。
ai_summary.relevance: 为具身智能中“感知退化下的鲁棒反应式操作”提供了可落地的世界模型+变阻抗控制范式，对机器人世界模型与 sim-to-real 鲁棒性研究有直接参考价值。

papers.title: SciFig2Data: A Workflow for Recovering Structured Data from Scientific Figures
papers.abstract: Scientific measurements reported in scholarly articles are often embedded in compound figures rather than available as machine-readable data. Recovering these measurements at literature scale requires an integrated workflow for figure localization, panel decomposition, chart identification, numerical reconstruction, and experimental context association. We present \textit{SciFig2Data}, an automated, high-throughput workflow for harvesting structured experimental data from scientific PDF repositories. The system integrates multi-scale document element detection, adaptive compound figure decomposition, two-stage OCR-based semantic filtering, Swin-based chart classification, and instruction-guided multimodal large language model (MLLM) reconstruction. It further incorporates directory-level batch execution, caching, and structured logging to support large-scale processing. We demonstrate the workflow on two biomedical literature corpora comprising 605 toxicology and pharmacology articles and 551 lipid nanoparticle (LNP) articles. The pipeline successfully reconstructed 468 and 242 tabular outputs from the respective corpora, illustrating its practical applicability to literature-scale scientific data harvesting. By associating reconstructed measurements with caption-derived experimental metadata, SciFig2Data provides a workflow for transforming graphical evidence in scholarly publications into structured, context-enriched data records for downstream AI4Science applications.

ai_summary.problem: 科学论文中的实验测量数据常嵌入复合图中，难以作为机器可读数据获取，需要面向文献规模的结构化数据恢复流程。
ai_summary.method: 提出SciFig2Data自动化高通量工作流，集成多尺度文档元素检测、自适应复合图分解、两阶段OCR语义过滤、Swin图表分类和指令引导多模态大模型重建，并支持批处理、缓存与结构化日志。
ai_summary.result: 在两个生物医学语料库（605篇毒理学/药理学文章和551篇LNP文章）上分别重建出468和242个表格输出，验证了文献级科学数据采集的实用性。
ai_summary.novelty: 将复合图分解、图表分类、OCR过滤与MLLM数值重建整合为端到端工作流，并把重建测量与图注实验元数据关联成结构化记录。
ai_summary.relevance: 为AI4Science提供从科学图表中规模化抽取结构化实验数据的能力，可支撑多模态文档理解与科学数据挖掘。

papers.title: E-Waste-Bench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Visual Triage of Data-Center Hardware
papers.abstract: Retired data-center hardware can often be refurbished or resold, but triage demands more than object categories. A model must tell visually similar parts apart, judge condition under damage and occlusion, and read the printed part number. We audit nine public e-waste collections. They cover mostly consumer devices (only 10% of images are labeled as a data-center part), label neither condition nor printed text, and contain 42% exact or augmented duplicates. We introduce E-Waste-Bench, 328K photographs drawn from 762K deduplicated images and labeled for class (24 classes), granularity, condition and printed text. Images come from those collections and the web, where a recipe-based crawler works beside an agent built on an open-weight vision-language model. The agent vets new sources and reads sites the crawler cannot parse, and both are steered toward under-represented classes. Training labels are model-made, splits follow near-duplicate groups, and human annotators label a test set of nearly 10,000 images. We benchmark classification, condition, detection, text perception and cross-dataset transfer. On this test set, a ConvNeXt-T trained on E-Waste-Bench reaches 64.3% top-1, against 31.5% with the public collections alone. Near-duplicate leakage inflates top-1 by 3.0 points under model-made test labels but by less than 0.1 under human labels, so model-labeled benchmarks need group splits. Accuracy falls to 42.1% on marketplace and auction photographs, the closest proxy for hardware leaving service. Data and code will be released.

ai_summary.problem: 现有电子废弃物（e-waste）公开数据集主要覆盖消费级设备，缺少数据中心硬件类别、成色状况和印刷零件编号标注，且存在大量重复图像，无法支撑真实场景下的硬件分拣与再利用判断。
ai_summary.method: 构建 E-Waste-Bench：从 762K 去重图像中整理出 328K 张照片，标注 24 个类别、粒度、成色与印刷文字；数据来源包括九个公开数据集与网络抓取，抓取采用配方式爬虫与基于开源视觉语言模型的 Agent 协同（Agent 负责筛选新来源、解析难解析站点并偏向稀缺类别）。训练标签由模型生成，数据划分按近重复分组，测试集约 1 万张由人工标注，并在分类、成色、检测、文字感知和跨数据集迁移上建立评测。
ai_summary.result: 在该测试集上，用 E-Waste-Bench 训练的 ConvNeXt-T 达到 64.3% top-1，而仅用公开数据集只有 31.5%；近重复泄漏在模型标注下会把 top-1 虚高 3.0 个点，在人工标注下不足 0.1 个点，说明模型标注基准必须按组划分；在电商/拍卖照片（最接近退役硬件流出场景）上准确率降至 42.1%。
ai_summary.novelty: 首个面向数据中心硬件视觉分拣的大规模基准，同时标注成色与印刷零件号，并提出爬虫+VLM Agent 的定向数据采集与近重复分组评测范式。
ai_summary.relevance: 为多模态视觉模型在工业级细粒度识别、成色评估与文字读取等真实落地任务提供了可复现的评测基线和数据构建方法论。

key_lab_papers.title: Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D
key_lab_papers.abstract: While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate 3D geometry, how to effectively exploit it for precise and generalizable action prediction remains a central challenge. We introduce Hi3R-VLA, a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities - vision, language, and action - in explicit 3D geometry for robotic manipulation. Our model integrates spatially-aligned visual features and language conditioning into point cloud representations, enriching scene geometry with fine-grained, task-relevant semantics. It then anchors low-level control commands in the same 3D coordinate frame and uses 3D-RoPE enhanced action-to-point attention over coarse-to-fine point features to model geometric relationships between action targets and observed points. Our analysis demonstrates the importance of semantic fusion within 3D and spatial alignment between observations and actions. With fewer than 250M trainable parameters, Hi3R-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa, RLBench, RoboTwin2, DexJoCo and DexSuite across diverse manipulation tasks and embodiments, from single-arm and dual-arm grippers to dexterous hands. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate its effectiveness in the physical world. The model, code and dataset are publicly released at https://cshizhe.github.io/projects/hi3r_vla.html.

ai_summary.problem: 现有视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型虽越来越多地引入3D几何，但如何有效利用3D信息实现精确且可泛化的机器人动作预测仍是核心挑战。
ai_summary.method: 提出Hi3R-VLA，将视觉、语言和动作统一锚定在显式3D点云几何中；把空间对齐的视觉特征与语言条件融合进点云表示，并将低层控制命令锚定到同一3D坐标系，使用3D-RoPE增强的action-to-point注意力在由粗到细的点特征上建模动作目标与观测点之间的几何关系。
ai_summary.result: 模型少于250M可训练参数，在RoboCasa、RLBench、RoboTwin2、DexJoCo和DexSuite上，跨单臂、双臂夹爪和灵巧手等多种操作任务与具身形态达到SOTA，真机评估验证了物理世界有效性。
ai_summary.novelty: 核心创新是在显式3D几何中统一视觉、语言与动作模态，并将动作命令锚定到同一3D坐标框架，结合3D-RoPE增强的action-to-point注意力建模动作与场景点的几何关系。
ai_summary.relevance: 为3D几何驱动的VLA和具身操作提供了有效范式，有助于提升机器人操作在跨任务、跨本体形态下的精确性与泛化能力。

daily_insight.hot_topics: 今日论文明显集中在多模态与具身/机器人方向，尤其是世界模型、VLA、3D几何 grounding、双臂操作和仿真基准。评测与可靠性成为另一条主线，涵盖Agent工具效果判断、场景记忆、多模态MoE专家必要性以及VLM归因偏差。整体看，研究正从“能看能说”转向“在物理与交互环境中可验证地感知、预测和行动”。
daily_insight.lab_overlap: 今日大厂论文仅检测到Google一篇，方向为多模态VLA与3D几何/动作统一建模，暂无其他大厂在相同方向形成论文重合。因此不存在可直接比较的方法类似或竞争关系；Google的Hi3R-VLA偏向显式3D空间锚定与action-to-point注意力，属于具身多模态 grounding 路线。
daily_insight.signals: 多模态论文占比最高，且世界模型、VLA、机器人操作与基准测试密集出现，显示具身智能评测正从单一任务性能转向记忆、工具效果、物理交互和空间 grounding 等细分能力。另一个信号是“冻结大模型/视频模型 + 轻量策略/记忆/选择器”的路线增多，强调低训练成本复用世界先验。大厂参与度今日较低，仅Google出现在VLA方向。
